newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index - 3 Dec 8 week.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index - 3 Dec 8 week.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News consumer comfort index fell two points to -3.0 from -1.0 in the week ended December 8.

The survey, this time with 1,044 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
Respondents' confidence in the economy rose fell to -2.0 from 4.0 the previous week.
Confidence in personal finances decreased two points to 16 from 18 and Americans' rating of buying climate rose two points to -22.
Regionally, confidence held steady in the South and rose one point to -4.0 in the West. It fell seven points in the Midwest and two points in the Northeast.
